$description: Primitive design tokens — Cyber Yellow + Inter identity (Direction 4, 2026-10-29). Hand-edit ONLY files in apps/web/tokens/; everything else is generated. Never reference primitives directly from component code — consume semantic tokens. Neutral and status scales are Tailwind stone / green / red steps (see spec); brand steps are HSL derivations of #FFD300 (see spec).

breakpoint.$description: One breakpoint set, replacing the ad-hoc 440/639/767/768/1023 scatter. Boundaries align to the shipped media queries (max-width 639/767, min-width 768, max-width 1023).

container.$description: Container scale for max-w-* (Tailwind v4 defaults). Named separately from the spacing ladder: in Tailwind v4, max-w-<key> also resolves through the --spacing-* namespace, so the spacing tokens' xs/sm/md/lg/xl names silently captured max-w-md (=12px) etc. until this scale was defined (found by spec 142's mobile e2e on PR-136A: the login card collapsed to a 12px max-width).

emeraldHalo.$description: Operational status halo — Tailwind green-400 (dark operational colour) at the existing 0.50 halo alpha

goldFocus.$description: Pre-computed focus ring / focus border (both modes) — cyber yellow at the existing 0.35 focus alpha

goldHalo.$description: Queued status halo — cyber yellow at the existing 0.50 halo alpha

idleHalo.$description: Idle status halo — Tailwind stone-500 at the existing 0.40 halo alpha

roseHalo.$description: Critical status halo — Tailwind red-400 (dark critical colour) at the existing 0.50 halo alpha

darkHairline.$description: Tailwind stone-800 — dark hairline, one tonal step above the dark panel

facebook.$description: Facebook brand blue — the View on Facebook link on Page cards only (the platform's own brand colour, not a Binance accent)

bronze.$description: Deep yellow — RETAINED from the old palette for one reason only: light-mode link text. Pure #FFD300 on white is 1.44:1 (fails); bronze on white is 6.08:1 (passes AA).

emerald.$description: Legacy Binance trading-up green — RETAINED only so the generated PALETTE shape is unchanged (generator requires color.brand.emerald). Semantic status no longer references it; see color.status.

gold.$description: Cyber Yellow — primary brand colour, primary buttons, active moments (Direction 4). Buttons use dark #181a20 text on it (12.07:1); white text on it (1.44:1) is never used.

peru.$description: Cyber Yellow shade — hover/pressed state of the primary. HSL derivation of #FFD300: hue 50, saturation 100%, lightness 50% -> 40% (one 10-point step down).

rose.$description: Tailwind red-600 — light-mode critical/error. 4.83:1 on white (passes AA). Dark-mode critical uses color.status.criticalDark instead (red-600 is only 4.09:1 on dark canvas).

400.$description: Tailwind stone-400 — dark-mode muted text, light-mode idle dot

500.$description: Tailwind stone-500 — light-mode muted text and light-mode idle colour

mutedLight.$description: Tailwind stone-400 — light-mode idle status dot (same step as gray.400)

600.$description: Tailwind stone-600 — light-mode secondary text (same step as slateText)

black.$description: Pitch black — retained neutral (not a surface in the new system; surfaces use stone-950)

slate.$description: Tailwind stone-800 — dark hairline / divider step (replaces the old blue-grey slate)

lightCanvas.$description: Tailwind stone-50 — light page floor (warm off-white; the mockup's #fafaf7 is 2 RGB units away — the standard scale step is used so every neutral is a scale step)

lightHover.$description: Tailwind stone-100 — light hover surface (one step darker than the white panel, standard light-state pattern)

darkCanvas.$description: Tailwind stone-950 — dark page floor (darkest step; layering rises 950 -> 900 -> 800 -> 700 -> 600)

darkPrimary.$description: Tailwind stone-50 — body text on dark (18.92:1 on stone-950)

lightPrimary.$description: Tailwind stone-900 — body text on light (17.49:1 on white)

onPrimary.$description: Dark ink on the cyber-yellow primary — RETAINED exact value #181a20 from the old lightPrimary so primary buttons keep their checked 12.07:1 ratio in both modes

successLight.$description: Tailwind green-700 — light operational text. green-600 is only 3.30:1 on white (fails AA); green-700 is 5.02:1 on white, 4.60:1 on stone-100

successDark.$description: Tailwind green-400 — dark operational text. 11.34:1 on stone-950

criticalDark.$description: Tailwind red-400 — dark critical text. red-600 is only 4.09:1 on stone-950 (fails AA); red-400 is 7.14:1

criticalOnTintDark.$description: Tailwind red-200 — dark critical text ON a tinted/subtle/hover/active background. red-300 is only 4.02:1 on stone-600 active (fails AA); red-200 is 5.27:1 on stone-600 active, 7.10:1 on stone-700 hover, 8.34:1 on a 15% critical tint over stone-800, 10.48:1 on stone-800 panel and 13.66:1 on stone-950 canvas

criticalOnTintLight.$description: Tailwind red-700 — light critical text ON a tinted/subtle/hover background. red-600 is only 4.13:1 on a 10% tint, 3.81:1 on a 15% tint and 4.43:1 on stone-100 (fails AA); red-700 is 5.54:1 on the 10% tint, 5.10:1 on the 15% tint and 5.93:1 on stone-100

mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

sans.$value: var(--font-inter), system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
sans.$description: Inter (loaded via next/font/google in layout.tsx, variable --font-inter) with the old system stack as fallback. Sizes, line-heights, tracking and weights are unchanged — see spec for why no size change is needed.

size.$description: Type scale — 1.25 modular ratio on a 13px product body (compact default density — Shahzeb, 2026-10-24; spec 129 OD-4 as amended). The 12px step is the named metadata step (body − 1px), not an accident.

body.$description: Product body size (1rem = 16px; body renders at 0.8125rem — the legacy app's de-facto size, now the specced compact default)

metadata.$description: Named metadata step — dense tables, captions, secondary labels

motion.$description: Motion — exit faster than enter (exit uses the next-shorter duration step). Reduced-motion handling lives in the base CSS layer (PR-F2).

full.$description: Material 3 shape full — circular avatars and round indicators only (unchanged)

md.$description: Material 3 shape large (16px) — cards, data tables, sheets, dialogs (was 8px)

sm.$description: Material 3 shape medium (12px) — buttons, form inputs, select triggers (was 6px)

xs.$description: Material 3 shape small (8px) — checkboxes, micro switches, segmented toggles (was 4px)

shadow.$description: Elevation — tonal surface steps + hairlines are the depth mechanism; shadows exist ONLY for true overlays (menus, dialogs, toasts) and raised cards, per mode.

space.$description: Spacing ladder — 4/8 system (spec 129 §5.2). The xs–xxxl steps mirror the legacy SPACING export; section/page steps extend the ladder to 64/96.

lg.$description: Standard container padding, card inner margins

sm.$description: Compact element spacing, input internal padding Y

state.$description: Pre-computed state values (Geist pattern) — components consume these instead of hand-mixing rgba() or opacity at the usage site.

zIndex.$description: Named z-index scale (spec 129 §5.2) replacing the 9500/9999/10000 arms race. Step VALUES preserve today's effective stacking order for existing usages — see the usage→step mapping in PR-F1. F1 defines the tokens only; usage sites migrate in specs 130–136.

base.$description: Normal flow; absorbs today's local 1/2/3/20/40/50/100 stacking inside components

overlayTop.$description: Topmost overlay — desktop titlebar and tooltips (today's 10000 usages; currently the highest stacking in the app)

sticky.$description: Sticky chrome — sidebar container (CSS z-index 30 today) and its rail (20, inside the container's stacking context)

toast.$description: Toasts and top-level guards (today's 9999 usages — ui/dialog overlay tier, leave-page guard, media import staging, media library header)
